name: ca-daily-and-seventh-day
summary: A California worker (Ontario, CA) at $18.00/h, billed at $26.00/h (overtime 1.5×, double time 2×), works all seven days of the workweek Sunday October 4 to Saturday October 10, 2026: 8, 10, 13, 8, 8, 6 and 10 hours (63 h). Monday's 2 and Tuesday's 4 hours over 8 are daily overtime; Tuesday's hour over 12 is double time. The 40 straight hours are reached on Thursday, so Friday's 6 hours are weekly overtime (daily-overtime hours never count toward the 40). Saturday is the seventh day worked: its first 8 hours are overtime, the last 2 double time (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a)). Pay: 40 h × $18 = $720.00; overtime 2 h + 4 h + 6 h + 8 h = 20 h × $27 = $540.00; double time 1 h + 2 h = 3 h × $36 = $108.00; total $1,368.00 (treating Saturday as an ordinary day would pay $1,350.00). Bill: 40 h × $26 + 20 h × $39 + 3 h × $52 = $1,976.00.

payLines.explain: Regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $18.00/h = 72000¢ exactly → $720.00. Rule straight_time: hours not paid at a daily, seventh-day or weekly premium in the workweek starting 2026-10-04.

Overtime: 6h 00m (360 min) × $27.00/h (1.5 × $18.00) = 16200¢ exactly → $162.00. Rule ca_daily_overtime: hours over 8h 00m in a workday, on 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06 (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a) — over 8 hours in a workday at not less than 1.5x the regular rate).

Overtime: 6h 00m (360 min) × $27.00/h (1.5 × $18.00) = 16200¢ exactly → $162.00. Rule weekly_overtime: 46h 00m worked in the workweek starting 2026-10-04 not already paid at a daily or seventh-day premium is 6h 00m over the 40h 00m threshold (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a) — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate; Fair Labor Standards Act, 29 U.S.C. § 207(a)(1); 29 C.F.R. Part 778 — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate; DLSE Opinion Letter 2000.01.19).

Overtime: 8h 00m (480 min) × $27.00/h (1.5 × $18.00) = 21600¢ exactly → $216.00. Rule ca_seventh_day: 2026-10-10 is the seventh day of work in the workweek starting 2026-10-04 (all seven days were worked) (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a); IWC Wage Orders § 3(A) — first 8 hours on the seventh day of work in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate).

Double time: 1h 00m (60 min) × $36.00/h (2 × $18.00) = 3600¢ exactly → $36.00. Rule ca_daily_double_time: hours over 12h 00m in a workday, on 2026-10-06 (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a) — over 12 hours in a workday at not less than 2x the regular rate).

Double time: 2h 00m (120 min) × $36.00/h (2 × $18.00) = 7200¢ exactly → $72.00. Rule ca_seventh_day_double_time: hours over 8h 00m on 2026-10-10, the seventh day of work in the workweek starting 2026-10-04 (Cal. Lab. Code § 510(a); IWC Wage Orders § 3(A) — over 8 hours on the seventh day of work in a workweek at not less than 2x the regular rate).

billLines.explain: Billed regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $26.00/h = 104000¢ exactly → $1,040.00. Bill rate from the rate card.

Billed overtime (ca_daily_overtime hours): 6h 00m (360 min) × $39.00/h (1.5 × $26.00 bill rate) = 23400¢ exactly → $234.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.

Billed overtime (weekly_overtime hours): 6h 00m (360 min) × $39.00/h (1.5 × $26.00 bill rate) = 23400¢ exactly → $234.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.

Billed overtime (ca_seventh_day hours): 8h 00m (480 min) × $39.00/h (1.5 × $26.00 bill rate) = 31200¢ exactly → $312.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.

Billed double time (ca_daily_double_time hours): 1h 00m (60 min) × $52.00/h (2 × $26.00 bill rate) = 5200¢ exactly → $52.00. Client bills double time at the rate-card double time multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.

Billed double time (ca_seventh_day_double_time hours): 2h 00m (120 min) × $52.00/h (2 × $26.00 bill rate) = 10400¢ exactly → $104.00. Client bills double time at the rate-card double time multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.
